question: Let vectors $\vec{a} = 3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - \hat{k}$ and $\vec{b} = 2\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + t\hat{k}$ be such that $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 4$ and $\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$ is perpendicular to $\vec{c} = \hat{i} + x\hat{j} + y\hat{k}$. If $x = 2y$, find the value of $t$ and the possible values of $y$.
explanation:
First use $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 4$:

$3(2) + 2(-2) + (-1)t = 4$

$6 - 4 - t = 4$

$2 - t = 4$

$t = -2$

Now compute $\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$:

$\begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & 2 & -1 \\ 2 & -2 & -2 \end{vmatrix}$

$= \hat{i}(2\times -2 - (-1)\times -2) - \hat{j}(3\times -2 - (-1)\times 2) + \hat{k}(3\times -2 - 2\times 2)$

$= \hat{i}(-4 - 2) - \hat{j}(-6 + 2) + \hat{k}(-6 - 4)$

$= -6\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - 10\hat{k}$

Since it is perpendicular to $\vec{c} = \hat{i} + x\hat{j} + y\hat{k}$:

$(-6)(1) + 4x - 10y = 0$

$-6 + 4x - 10y = 0$

Substitute $x = 2y$:

$-6 + 8y - 10y = 0$

$-6 - 2y = 0$

$y = -3$

Thus $x = 2y = -6$.

Final result: $t = -2$ and $y = -3$.
